subject: English
passage: Narrative of Sojourner Truth is an 1850 autobiographical narrative by Sojourner Truth. In the work, Truth directly addresses the reader to establish her authority and credibility, writing ______
prompt: Which quotation from Narrative of Sojourner Truth most effectively illustrates the claim?

choices.A: "Oh, dear readers, these masters had traveled only forty miles southward to the old plantation, where my people were then living and laboring."
choices.B: "I was born in the year 1797, though I cannot say with certainty in which month."
choices.C: "My dear reader, I have not lived in this world for over fifty years for nothing, and I know whereof I speak."
choices.D: "But how can I describe the suffering that followed? Some of you, dear readers, can well imagine."

explanation: Choice C is the best answer because it most effectively illustrates how Truth directly addresses the reader to establish authority and credibility. The quotation contains all required elements: direct address ('My dear reader'), explicit claim of authority through extensive life experience ('I have not lived in this world for over fifty years for nothing'), and assertion of credibility ('I know whereof I speak'). This final phrase directly claims firsthand knowledge and epistemic authority, making it the clearest illustration of the claim.
